SearchWatermark: Search files and folders... (leave empty to browse everything)
StatusChooseOption: Choose an option to start scanning
ContentSearchWatermark: Text to search inside files — press Enter...
SelectFolderOrScanAll: Select a folder or scan the whole PC
ContentReadyPrompt: Ready — type text and press Enter to search
SelectFolderFirstContent: Select a folder to search first
JobFinishedWithErrors: Finished, but some items were skipped
JobErrorIntoItself: a folder can't be copied into itself
JobClipboardEmpty: The clipboard has no copied files
ConflictApplyToAll: Do this for all remaining conflicts
NameSearchSubtitle: Find files and folders by name — results appear as you type.
ContentSearchSubtitle: Search for text inside documents, code and spreadsheets.
SettingsSubtitle: Choose how Grepdesk integrates with your system.
ExplorerMenuDescription: Add Grepdesk entries to Explorer's right-click menu. Stored for the current user only, no admin rights needed. On Windows 11 they appear under "Show more options".
FileManagerMenuDescription: Add Grepdesk entries to your file manager's right-click menu.
IntegrationUnsupported: Right-click menu integration isn't available on this platform yet.
FeatureOpenWithHint: On folders: open Grepdesk with that folder ready to search.
FeatureExtractHint: On .zip files: "Extract here" and "Extract to folder".
FeatureCompressHint: On files and folders: create a zip archive.
FeaturePasteHint: On folders: fast copy or move of files you copied/cut in Explorer.
ResultsShowingTop: {0:N0} results for "{1}" — showing the first {2:N0} in this order
LanguageDescription: Language of the app and of its Explorer menu entries.
ShowPreviewHint: Shows the selected result next to the list: images, the start of text and code files, and the text of documents. Hidden automatically when the window is narrow.
PreviewEmpty: Select a result to preview it here
PreviewFailed: This file could not be read
PreviewUnavailable: No preview for this file type
AllItemsShowingTop: {0:N0} items in the scanned folders — showing the first {1:N0} in this order
ShortcutMoveToResults: Move between the search box and the results
ShortcutShowInFolder: Show the selected result in its folder
ShortcutTrash: Move the selected result to the Recycle Bin
ShortcutEscape: Back to the search box (clears it when already there)
TrashConfirmFolder: Move the folder "{0}" and everything in it to the Recycle Bin?
TrashFailed: Could not move to the Recycle Bin
PreviewPdfNoText: This PDF has no text layer (probably a scanned document)
FileCopied: "{0}" copied — paste it anywhere in Explorer
ShortcutCopyFile: Copy the selected file itself (paste in Explorer)
DiskSubtitle: What is filling your drive: by kind of file, by folder, and the largest files.
DiskEmpty: Pick a drive and click Analyze. The first analysis scans the whole drive, which can take a minute or two on a large disk. If you already scanned the entire PC on the file name page, that scan is reused.
DiskAnalyzed: Analyzed at {0}. Sizes reflect that moment; analyze again after big changes.
DiskNoteUnreadable: {0} could not be read: other users' folders, System Volume Information, restore points and file system data.
DiskNoteCloud: {0} of online-only cloud files (OneDrive etc.) is not counted: those don't use this disk.
DiskCategoriesHint: Click a kind to list its largest files. Where a file lives decides its kind first: a video inside a game folder counts as the game.
